comments.body:
Why not using os.UseConfigDir ?

https://pkg.go.dev/os#UserConfigDir

It's implementation might be what you are looking for

https://cs.opensource.google/go/go/+/refs/tags/go1.22.5:src/os/file.go;l=509
UserConfigDir also looks at the home dir `os.GetEnv("HOME")`  if `os.GetEnv("XDG_CONFIG_HOME")` is empty which isn't wanted here.

> On Darwin, it returns $HOME/Library/Application Support

I think it wouldn't change much in that particular problem.

We can work on replacing the usage of gap with this library though

Please note, I know some macOS users expect to use this folder by default, but want code to respect XDG_CONFIG_HOME if present.

- https://github.com/charmbracelet/glow/pull/594#issuecomment-2189627733
yes, this is what this PR does...

It's great that you found how to add things to viper directly.

One question anyway.

Does it respect the order?

Meaning if you have charm env + xdg env

Which one would be used ?

Did you check?
